newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 23.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 23.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had two large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The misses occurred on Tuesday and Thursday, causing there to be more reserves in the banking system, due to Treasury deposits at the Federal Reserve being much lower than anticipated.
The high in natural float was a bit under $3.3 billion on Wednesday, while the low was a bit under $500 million on Tuesday.

Transportation float averaged at about $250 million per day, with the high on Friday at a bit under $400 million, primarily due to transportation problems at the East Rutherford operations center and scattered weather problems in Detroit.
